name: karni-reports
summary: Reports for Karni: a row printed to PDF from an HTML template in the background, cached by template and data, served only to users who may see the row. Karni is an open-source Django + React framework for building with AI coding agents. Your agent writes only your domain. The API, admin, permissions and React screens come from a package you upgrade, not code it rewrites in each project. One rule set covers every coding agent. The build fails when an agent hand-writes what Karni ships.
